findings.title: Bucket Name Mismatch
findings.problem: Design specifies uploading to bucket 'images', but existing SupabaseUploader.jsx uses 'portfolio-projects'
findings.fix: Choose one bucket name: Option A (RECOMMENDED): Update design to use 'portfolio-projects'. Option B: Update SupabaseUploader.jsx to use 'images' and verify no other code references the old bucket.

findings.title: Status Enum Not Actually Updated
findings.problem: Design claims status enum was replaced with ['draft', 'published'], but backend/models/projects.js still has the old enum ['Active', 'Completed', 'In Progress']. Mongoose validation will reject any save with the new status values.
findings.fix: Update backend/models/projects.js lines 64-72 to: status: { type: String, enum: ['draft', 'published'], default: 'draft' }. Then run a migration to update all existing projects: await Project.updateMany({ status: { $in: ['Active', 'Completed', 'In Progress'] } }, { $set: { status: 'published' } })

findings.title: Public Endpoint Does Not Filter by Status
findings.problem: Design Section 3 proposes filtering public /projects endpoint to only return status='published', but backend/controllers/projectController.js getProjects() function returns ALL projects unfiltered. Drafts will be visible to users.
findings.fix: Update backend/controllers/projectController.js lines 3-15 to add filter: const projects = await Project.find({ status: 'published' }).sort({ createdAt: -1 }). Also update getFeaturedProjects() to include status filter.

findings.title: ImageUploader Component Reuse Ambiguity
findings.problem: Design proposes creating a new ImageUploader.jsx component, but SupabaseUploader.jsx already exists and provides all required functionality (batch upload, previews, progress bars, drag-and-drop). Design does not clarify whether to create a new component, reuse existing, or refactor existing.
findings.location: design.md Section 2 vs src/components/SupabaseUploader.jsx and src/pages/admin/ProjectsPage.jsx:8
findings.fix: Option A (RECOMMENDED): Reuse existing SupabaseUploader. Update design to remove 'File to Create: ImageUploader.jsx' and document that ProjectFormModal will integrate with SupabaseUploader. Option B: Create new ImageUploader as a wrapper/enhancement around SupabaseUploader and document the relationship.
